snippet.title: A Storied Life - Tabitha Gameplay - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
A Storied Life: Tabitha is a wholesome narrative puzzle game about the objects we leave behind and the stories they tell. You will complete a loved one's damaged memoirs by exploring their home and packing away their things, piecing together their hidden past using the items you inherit. This exclusive gameplay was revealed in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase.

The game will be launching on Steam in 2026. Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749330
